description:
A single OpenSearch analysis component: a tokenizer, a char filter, or a token filter. Two shapes:

Built-in component — just the OpenSearch name:

{ "name": "standard" }
{ "name": "lowercase" }
{ "name": "html_strip" }

Custom component — any unique name + an OpenSearch JSON definition under definition:

{
  "name": "my_edge_ngram",
  "definition": "{\"type\":\"edge_ngram\",\"min_gram\":2,\"max_gram\":20}"
}

{
  "name": "my_stop",
  "definition": "{\"type\":\"stop\",\"stopwords\":[\"the\",\"a\",\"of\"]}"
}

For the full inventory of types and parameters see the OpenSearch docs for tokenizers, char filters, and token filters. At index-build time custom-component names are namespaced by their owning TextAnalyzer's qualified name so multiple analyzers can reuse the same local name without collision.

name.description: Required. For a built-in, the OpenSearch built-in name (e.g. 'standard', 'lowercase', 'html_strip', 'icu_tokenizer', 'phonetic'). For a custom component, any identifier unique within the owning TextAnalyzer.

definition.description:
Optional. A JSON object string carrying the OpenSearch component definition; required when the component is not a built-in. The JSON object must include a type field naming the OpenSearch component type — see for example the edge_ngram tokenizer, the stop token filter, or the pattern_replace char filter.

AOSS note: file-based parameters are not supported — any key ending in _path (stopwords_path, synonyms_path, mappings_path, protected_words_path, rules_path, etc.) is rejected at create/update time. Use the inline equivalents (stopwords, synonyms, mappings, protected_words).
